item.title: Keep patched: ConnectWise ScreenConnect: Improper Privilege Management and Missing Authorization
item.description:
ConnectWise ScreenConnect: Privilege escalation · low-privileged account · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 26.6.5.9742

First step: Update ConnectWise ScreenConnect to 26.6.5.9742 or later.

ConnectWise ScreenConnect contains both an improper privilege management and missing authorization vulnerability that may allow an attacker to transfer and execute files through an active remote session without authorization or host confirmation.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-84869
